propositions: SKILL.md lacks a Step 0 that searches the tracker for existing duplicate reports before filing a new bug.
The skill does not establish a floor version (reported-against) using either explicit rebar --version output or the ticket's created_at nanosecond field converted to unix seconds.
The tracker search must include closed tickets (759 of 764 bug tickets are closed) rather than open-only sweeps which miss the majority of prior reports.
The nanosecond created_at value must be divided by 1000000000 to convert to unix seconds for git rev-list --before@ ; the raw nanosecond form silently returns main tip.
Step 0 must create a duplicates link on match, which requires explicit pre-approval in the approval-gate carve-out paragraph.
The skill must confirm the worktree HEAD matches origin/main and record the reported-against floor's git history changes in suspect paths.
